description: This file defines a class SearchChannelProvider that provides channel search suggestions in a chat application, handling pretext changes, filtering channels, loading profiles, and sorting channels for display.

classes.name: SearchChannelProvider
classes.description: A provider class that offers channel search suggestions based on user input, filtering, sorting, and loading additional profile data as needed.

methods.name: handlePretextChanged
methods.description: Handles changes in the search input pretext, triggers autocomplete, filters channels, loads profiles for group channels, sorts channels, and invokes the results callback.
